description: This file defines a configuration class for Fal AI's Imagen4 image generation model, including methods for parameter mapping, request transformation, and response processing. It interacts with external image generation APIs, maps parameters, and handles the response data to produce a standardized format.

classes.name: FalAIImagen4Config
classes.description: Configuration class for the Fal AI Imagen4 image generation model, handling parameter mapping, request creation, and response transformation.

methods.name: List[OpenAIImageGenerationOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI image generation optional parameters supported for the Imagen4 model.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI image generation parameters to Imagen4-specific parameters, handling supported and unsupported parameters, and converting sizes to aspect ratios.

methods.name: str _map_aspect_ratio(self, size: str)
methods.description: Maps a size string (like '1024x1024') to an aspect ratio string ('1:1', '16:9', etc.), defaulting to '1:1' when unrecognized.

methods.name: dict transform_image_generation_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms a request to generate an image into the appropriate format for the Imagen4 API, incorporating prompt and optional parameters.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_generation_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ImageResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes the raw response from the Imagen4 API, extracting image URLs and seed information, and converting it into the internal ImageResponse format.
